purpose: forward-only errata: what the P2-D0 stage reported as complete but which the P2-D1 inspection shows remained incomplete. Historical P2-D0 evidence is NOT rewritten; this file records the correction forward.

entries.p2d0Claim: the recorder preserves every distinct valid IPC Session identity
entries.p2d1Finding: preservation is correct AT THE RECORDER, but the PRODUCT sink in src/composition/continuation.ts calls recordIdentity(entry) and DISCARDS the returned IngestionOutcome. A REJECTED or THROWN append therefore leaves no completeness marker anywhere, and the later finalization writes CLOSED from the STORE candidate count. F1.

the post-read recheck compares only the SELECTED invocation event ids. It does not re-read the Attempt invocation set (F2) nor the cross-Attempt foreign creator claim set (F3), and it does not carry the qualifier basis across the handoff (F4).

capsuleForConsumer() refuses only NO_DURABLE_EVIDENCE. An AMBIGUOUS / RACED / unread origin still returns AUTHORIZED with an unadmitted, empty-event Capsule (F5/F6). Consumer authorization is not separated from Origin execution admission.

the bound is CHARACTERS of event summaries, not the serialized Capsule BYTES. The whole Capsule is never measured against a hard ceiling (F7), and uncertainty fields (otherInvocationsUnresolved, durability, synthetic/inherited counts) are defaulted rather than derived (F8).

entries.p2d0Claim: a bounded read-only Capsule for an authorized consumer
entries.p2d1Finding: no shipped test demonstrates a REAL A0 -> Governed Rework -> A1 -> capsuleForConsumer(A1) === AUTHORIZED path (F11), and makeCapsuleAuthorization() maintains a SEPARATE event scan rather than reusing the Context Owner reworkProvenanceBefore semantics (F9).

the Capsule is obtainable only by a DIRECT operator call to capsuleForConsumer(). No Capsule reaches Compiled Context, an Attempt-bound Handle, Context Pull or Host Prework, and no delivery digest/size is recorded (F12/F13). Delivery is not established.

note: these are corrections of P2-D0 SCOPE completeness, not rewrites of P2-D0 evidence; every P2-D0 evidence file remains byte-identical.
